title: Heart rate variability (RMSSD)
text: Record at rest, at the same time of day, with the same device. Day-to-day changes matter more than any single value; there is no published single-reading limit.
A sustained fall against the personal baseline is worth mentioning to the crew medical officer at the next check-in.
design_note: Baseline scoring only: no published single-reading limit.

citations.title: Heart Rate Variability: Standards of Measurement, Physiological Interpretation and Clinical Use
